reason: The submitted CIF parses and symmetry-expands as ordered I4/mmm (No. 139) with a = b = 4.51504 A, c = 14.67903 A, 16 atoms and Z = 2 (La4Cu4Se2S2O4), unit occupancies, and an 8-atom primitive cell containing one La2Cu2SeSO2 formula unit. The tetragonal cell indexes the important pattern lines with 33 refined peak positions at about 0.0031 degrees RMS and no important unindexed reflection. Atomic-coordinate evidence is present: the instantiated whole-profile fit refines La z to about 0.2085-0.2087; an independent equal-weight profile check gives about 6.8% residual versus a 5.4% free-intensity lower bound, whereas the S/Se-swapped realization gives about 41%, and enumeration of all composition-compatible assignments over the 4e/4c/4d/2a/2b sites isolates the submitted ordering. The notable weak 002 intensity mismatch does not support a concrete alternate ordering or framework. Nominal La3+/Cu+/Se2-/S2-/O2- charges balance, bond-valence analysis assigns those oxidation states, and complete periodic shells show plausible La-O (2.338 A) and Cu-S/Se (2.258 A) bonds without overlaps. No concrete diffraction-compatible incompatible realization survives, so another attempt is unlikely to add a materially different viable candidate.
